decision.observation: 9 mph, gear R, timer 40:47.809, seven dots blue, red X lit. The S+A recovery swung the car back down-frame onto the gravel; it now sits on the road's upper edge, nose pointing up-frame toward the grass and the line of pines, with the road running left-right across the frame.
decision.hypothesis: Gear R at 9 mph with the road under the car: plain W converts to gear 1 and drives up-frame; the nose is angled toward the grass so a second or so of plain W will carry it partly off, but the conversion bleed keeps speed low enough to correct afterwards.
decision.memory: Ninth successful S+A recovery, again landing the car on the gravel edge from a right-side pine pin. Nose-up-frame means forward motion drifts toward the top grass unless a brief steer follows.
